name: clipboard-search
description: A clipboard containing a circular search lens and short handle.
useCase: Search saved clipboard entries or a clipboard checklist.
misuse: Use search for a general search action without clipboard context.

16.reason: The lens sits within the writing area with a clear white counter and a short connected handle; the original clip and frame stay unchanged.

24.reason: The complete lens and handle stay clear of the full original clip and frame.
